_note: OWNER-APPROVED (2026-10-09) governance values for the Escrow 2.1 deployment on uni-7 (Juno TESTNET) ONLY. Source record, not a deployment: nothing here was sent to any chain by this repository. Copy treasury, resolver and params into the 2.1 instantiate message and the verifier's --expect file (escrow21-expect.example.json); the server's Juno document must list the resolver in trust.resolvers. There is NO decided mainnet Ludum DAO address: never reuse this testnet address on juno-1.

ludum_dao.daodao_indexer: none: testnet.daodao.zone shows `No indexer for chain` for Juno testnet indexed data, so the game's appeal workflow must not depend on DAO DAO's hosted indexer or frontend

appeals.challenge: a player's Challenge moves the escrow game to DISPUTED; the escrow and the backend NEVER create a DAO proposal because a challenge occurred
appeals.proposal: Ludum governors are offered a Create Appeal Proposal workflow for a DISPUTED game: prefilled dispute / game context and the escrow `Resolve { chain_game_id, outcome }` message for the Ludum DAO core to execute
appeals.submission: a Ludum DAO member submits and signs the proposal with their own wallet; the DAO votes; if it passes, the Ludum DAO core executes the escrow `Resolve`
appeals.relayer: the relayer is NOT a Ludum DAO member and never submits proposals
appeals.status: workflow NOT implemented yet: a Phase-3 remaining-work item (ROADMAP_3_2_REMAINING_WORK.md; docs/phase3/phase3_accounting.json escrow21_release_readiness.ludum_governance)
